# Supabase JavaScript SDK

Vendored official UMD browser distribution, version 2.57.4.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.57.4/dist/umd/supabase.js
License: SUPABASE-LICENSE (MIT).

Loaded locally and only when Supabase is configured; no runtime CDN dependency.
To upgrade, download and review the official pinned distribution and license, update
the filename in cms-client.js, and rerun the CMS browser checks.
